title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Road Corridor 2 Resilience and Modernization Project

description.narrative: The project will modernize and upgrade an approximately 87 kilometers section of the Guzar-Bukhara-Nukus-Beyneu (A380) highway in the Republic of Karakalpakstan (sovereign republic within the Republic of Uzbekistan). It aims to enhance a key segment of the CAREC Road Corridor 2, a critical regional trade route. The project will support the Committee for Roads under the Ministry of Transport in improving road maintenance and resilience, enforcing vehicle load limits, and enhancing traffic management through intelligent transport systems and weigh-in-motion technologies. Additionally, the project will build on the efforts of the Asian Development Bank and other development partners to develop this vital CAREC Road Corridor 2, contributing to Uzbekistan's economic growth by improving transport connectivity.
